Description: Workshop 6A. @Cacheable symbol lookup + Caffeine TTL/eviction policies with Micrometer stats. Groups TICKET-ADV081 through ADV082.
Workshop 6B. Counter, Timer, Gauge, DistributionSummary emitted to /actuator/prometheus. Groups TICKET-ADV083 through ADV086.
Workshop 6C. Grafana panels (rate, latency percentiles, heatmap, stat, pie) + Prometheus alert rules. Groups TICKET-ADV087 through ADV094.
Workshop 6D. Custom Spring Boot starter, runtime JMX beans, concurrent performance test. Groups TICKET-ADV095 through ADV097.

GOAL: wrap the symbol lookup so a second call for the same symbol hits memory, not the DB. DONE WHEN: a log line inside findBySymbol prints on the first call but not the second for the same symbol. /actuator/caches lists an instruments cache. Calling the endpoint twice shows the second response visibly faster (sub-ms after the first hit).

Summary: TICKET-ADV082 — Cache eviction: TTL 5 min instruments, 1 min counterparties
Description: GOAL: two separately-named Caffeine caches with different TTL policies + stats hooks Micrometer needs. DONE WHEN: /actuator/caches lists both instruments and counterparties. A symbol cached at T=0 expires by T=5m30s; a counterparty by T=1m30s. /actuator/prometheus exposes cache_gets_total with labels cache=instruments, result=hit after a warm read.

GOAL: emit a monotonically increasing counter on each successful trade creation. DONE WHEN: /actuator/prometheus lists trade_created_total with a # HELP line. Creating three trades then re-scraping shows the value up by exactly three. Counter constructed once at bean creation, not inside the service method.

GOAL: measure recon engine time per batch, publish the distribution so PromQL percentiles work. DONE WHEN: /actuator/prometheus lists reconciliation_duration_seconds_count, _sum, _bucket. histogram_quantile(0.95, ...) over _bucket returns non-zero after a few reconciliations. Timer wraps the engine call without losing the caller's return value.

GOAL: publish a current-value sample of how many recon breaks are OPEN. DONE WHEN: /actuator/prometheus shows recon_break_count tracking the live DB count. Closing a break via the API then re-scraping drops the value. Gauge pulls from a supplier — no code calls .set(...).

GOAL: record the distribution of trade notional values (USD) so you can answer P95 trade size. DONE WHEN: /actuator/prometheus lists trade_value_total_count, _sum, _bucket. Metric has a base_unit or HELP line indicating USD. Summary recorded once per successful trade alongside the ADV083 counter increment.

Summary: TICKET-ADV087 — Grafana panel: API request rate by endpoint
Description: GOAL: time-series panel showing requests-per-second broken out by URI. DONE WHEN: panel renders a non-empty series after exercising a few endpoints. Each line labelled by URI, not a tangle of method/status/instance. Y-axis unit reads as requests-per-second.

Summary: TICKET-ADV088 — Grafana panel: API response time P50/P95/P99
Description: GOAL: three-line panel showing median, 95th, 99th percentile latency per endpoint. DONE WHEN: panel shows three labelled lines P50/P95/P99. Lines non-zero after exercising the API. Axis renders in human-readable time units (auto ms/us scale).

Summary: TICKET-ADV089 — Grafana panel: trade_created_total over time
Description: GOAL: time-series panel showing trades-per-second created. DONE WHEN: panel renders a non-flat line after POSTing a handful of trades. Legend reads as a trade-create rate, not a raw cumulative count. Unit is trades-per-second.

Summary: TICKET-ADV090 — Grafana histogram panel for reconciliation_duration_seconds
Description: GOAL: visualise recon engine latency distribution as a heatmap (density over time). DONE WHEN: heatmap renders with cells coloured by frequency after ~a dozen reconciliations. Y-axis represents bucket boundaries. X-axis represents time.

GOAL: single big-number tile showing current open-break count, coloured by severity. DONE WHEN: stat panel renders the current break count as one large number. Colour changes by threshold (green low, yellow mid, red high). Closing a break in the DB drops the number within one scrape interval.

Summary: TICKET-ADV092 — Grafana pie chart: trades by status
Description: GOAL: pie chart of current trade breakdown across statuses (PENDING, MATCHED, UNMATCHED, DISPUTED, CANCELLED). DONE WHEN: pie renders one slice per status. Slice labels show status name + count. Changing a trade's status and re-scraping shifts proportions within one scrape interval.

GOAL: Prometheus alert firing when open breaks stay above 50 continuously for 5 min. DONE WHEN: rule appears under /rules. Manually inflating the open-break count and waiting fires the alert (visible under /alerts). Alert has a severity label + a summary annotation.

Summary: TICKET-ADV094 — Alert: API P95 latency > 500ms for 3 min
Description: GOAL: Prometheus alert on P95 HTTP latency above 500ms continuously for 3 min. DONE WHEN: rule appears under /rules. A slow/throttled endpoint for 3+ minutes fires the alert. Alert annotation includes the current P95 value.

Summary: TICKET-ADV095 — Custom Spring Boot Starter: recon-audit-starter
Description: GOAL: package an audit-event publisher as a reusable starter that auto-configures on a consumer's classpath. DONE WHEN: new Maven module recon-audit-starter builds independently. recon-service depends on it via a single coordinate. Removing the dependency removes the auto-wired bean cleanly; re-adding re-enables it. reconx.audit.enabled=false in the consumer disables the auto-config.

Summary: TICKET-ADV096 — JMX beans: toggle caching, adjust recon tolerance at runtime
Description: GOAL: ReconConfig MBean letting an operator change price tolerance + toggle caching at runtime from JConsole, plus a clearCache() op. DONE WHEN: JConsole shows reconx:type=ReconConfig in the MBeans tree. Editing PriceTolerance changes the value the engine reads on the next run. Invoking clearCache() empties the Caffeine caches without a restart.

GOAL: drive 100 trade-creation requests at concurrency 10, observe load live on Grafana. DONE WHEN: 100 trades POST successfully (201) under the load tool. The ADV087 request-rate panel visibly spikes. The ADV088 P95 panel reports a non-trivial value during the spike. You record throughput (req/s) + P95 latency from the tool and Grafana.
